I've reviewed the filing and quote. Before ordering, one important flag: **the 10-K contains a contradictory "Explanatory Note – Restatement"** claiming FY2024 net sales of $431,035M, net income of $113,736M and diluted EPS of $7.38. That note does not survive arithmetic against the rest of the same filing:

- Products $294,866M + Services $96,169M = **$391,035M**, which matches the segment table, product table, geographic table and the $391,035M total printed in MD&A — not $431,035M. Also $431,035M − $210,352M cost of sales ≠ $180,683M gross margin, while $391,035M − $210,352M = $180,683M exactly.
- Net income: $123,485M pretax − $29,749M tax = **$93,736M**, the figure used in the cash flow statement, equity statement, comprehensive income statement and Note 3 — not $113,736M.
- Diluted EPS of $7.38 exceeds basic EPS of $6.11, which is impossible; $93,736M ÷ 15,408M diluted shares = **$6.08**, exactly as computed in Note 3.

So I'll rely on the internally verified figures and treat the "restatement" paragraph as unreliable.
